steps.en: On a GPU Kubernetes cluster, clone the repo, install the Inference Extension CRDs and an HF token secret
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，装 Inference Extension CRD 和 HF 密钥

steps.en: Install the llm-d Router with a well-lit-path values file
steps.zh: 按配方的 values 文件装 llm-d Router

steps.en: kubectl-apply the kustomize overlay that matches your hardware to start model-server pods
steps.zh: kubectl 应用对应硬件的 overlay，起模型 pod

steps.en: Pods join the InferencePool by label; the EPP starts scraping their queue and KV-cache metrics
steps.zh: pod 按标签进 InferencePool，EPP 抓排队和 KV 缓存指标

steps.en: Send OpenAI-compatible requests to the router's address
steps.zh: 把 OpenAI 兼容请求发到路由器地址

steps.en: Scores every pod by prefix-cache hit, queue depth and KV-cache load, and forwards to the best one
steps.zh: 按前缀命中、排队深度和 KV 缓存占用给 pod 打分，转给最合适的

value.en: Repeated long prompts land on the replica that already cached them, instead of a round-robin pick recomputing them
value.zh: 反复出现的长提示落到已缓存它的副本上，不再被轮询派到别处从头重算

sources: https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d/blob/main/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md (source ${REPO_ROOT}/guides/env.sh; GAIE CRDs; llm-d-hf-token secret; helm install ${GUIDE_NAME} ${ROUTER_STANDALONE_CHART}; kubectl apply -n ${NAMESPACE} -k guides/optimized-baseline/modelserver/gpu/vllm/base/; curl -X POST http://${IP}/v1/completions)
https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d/blob/main/docs/architecture/README.md (Router = Proxy + EPP; InferencePool label selector; EPP scores pods on real-time metrics and KV-cache affinity)
https://github.com/llm-d/llm-d/blob/main/docs/architecture/core/model-servers.md (pods join InferencePool via labels; EPP scrapes queue and KV-cache utilization metrics)
